family.not_applicable: absent from this checkpoint's label set. i2b2 2010 assertion has no temporality class at all, and this model dropped i2b2's associated_with_someone_else.

historical.not_applicable: absent from this checkpoint's label set. i2b2 2010 assertion has no temporality class at all, and this model dropped i2b2's associated_with_someone_else.

coverage: negated and uncertain only. historical has no published baseline in any assertion benchmark, which is the strongest argument for fine-tuning on this gold rather than reusing a checkpoint.
determinism: fixed weights, greedy argmax, CPU, torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), single thread. An encoder can therefore sit in a package that promises replayable edit scripts; an LLM API cannot.
input_form: the mention's sentence with the span wrapped in [entity] markers, as the checkpoint was trained. Spans come from stages 5-7, so this measures assertion alone, exactly as the ConText arms do.
model_provenance: Bio_Discharge_Summary_BERT fine-tuned on the i2b2 2010 assertion challenge (van Aken et al., NLPMC 2021).
pretraining_overlap: the base model is pretrained on MIMIC-III discharge summaries and this gold is MIMIC-IV; the corpora overlap in period and patients. That is PRETRAINING exposure, not fine-tuning on these labels, so it is weaker than leakage — but these numbers are not directly comparable to a model that never saw MIMIC.
question: Does a clinical encoder beat the shipped rules on our spans?
why: the rule-based effort is near its ceiling — a direction sweep bought historical +0.060 held out and the scope fix the error analysis pointed at did not generalise. ConText implements a 2001 algorithm; the published state of the art is a fine-tuned encoder.
why_uncertain_collapses: a LABEL-SEMANTICS mismatch, not a model failure. i2b2's `possible` is a diagnostic hedge on a condition — `possible pneumonia`. This package's `uncertain` deliberately merges that with the conditional case — `Tylenol PRN`, return precautions, future plans — because for modifying a concept's asserted presence a hedge and a condition are the same move. i2b2 keeps them apart as `possible` versus `conditional`/`hypothetical`, and this checkpoint dropped the latter two entirely. So it is answering a narrower question, and calls almost every conditional span PRESENT. The merge that made our own lexicon work is exactly what makes this checkpoint inapplicable to the dimension.
